items.prompt: A stored nonnegative notional is 4940 cents. Which display is correct without changing the stored unit?
items.explanation: There are 100 cents per dollar in this lesson contract. 4940 cents displays as USD 49.40; formatting does not change the stored integer.

options.text: USD 4940.00, because formatting preserves every digit
options.why: This treats cents as dollars without conversion.
That applies the cent conversion twice.
The 40-cent remainder is part of the amount.
divmod(4940,100) gives the dollar and cent components.
